title: Copy locally
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local old = pg:FindFirstChild("CopyLocation")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "CopyLocation"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 9999
gui.Parent = pg

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 190)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -95)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 34)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Parent = gui

Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local title = Instance.new("TextButton")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(105, 55, 190)
title.Text = "COPY LOCATION   [-]"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 15
title.Parent = frame

Instance.new("UICorner", title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 50)
box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 55)
box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 55)
box.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
box.Text = "Your position will appear here"
box.TextWrapped = true
box.TextSize = 13
box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
box.MultiLine = true
box.Parent = frame

Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 120)
btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(125, 65, 220)
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
btn.Text = "SHOW CODE"
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btn.TextSize = 15
btn.Parent = frame

Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local minimized = false

title.Activated:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    box.Visible = not minimized
    btn.Visible = not minimized

    frame.Size = minimized
        and UDim2.fromOffset(200, 40)
        or UDim2.fromOffset(300, 190)

    title.Text = minimized
        and "COPY LOCATION   [+]"
        or "COPY LOCATION   [-]"
end)

btn.Activated:Connect(function()
    local char = player.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if root then
        local p = root.Position
        box.Text = string.format(
            "Vector3.new(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f)",
            p.X, p.Y, p.Z
        )
    else
        box.Text = "Character not found"
    end
end)

-- Drag support for PC and mobile
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)
features: so you can copy your current location and create the script you want
